records.quote: The figure XYZL is a cyclic quadrilateral because:
records.label: Notice
records.claim: The figure XYZL is a cyclic quadrilateral because m(∠YXZ) = m(∠YLZ): they are two drawn angles on the base YZ and in one direction of it, so a circle can be drawn passing through the points X, Y, Z and L, i.e. the vertices of figure XYZL belong to one circle.

records.label: Example
records.quote: In the opposite figure : AB is a diameter in circle M
records.stem: In the opposite figure: AB is a diameter in circle M, X is the midpoint of AC and ray XM intersecting the tangent of the circle at B in Y. Prove that: the figure AXBY is a cyclic quadrilateral.
solution: Given: AB is a diameter in the circle M where AX = CX, ray BY is a tangent to the circle at B.
R.T.P.: AXBY is a cyclic quadrilateral.
Proof: ∵ X is the midpoint of AC ∴ MX ⊥ AC, m(∠AXY) = 90°
∵ AB is a diameter and, ray BY is a tangent at B ∴ BY ⊥ AB, m(∠ABY) = 90°
They are two drawn angles on the base AY and in one direction of it.
∴ Figure AXBY is a cyclic quadrilateral.

records.label: Example
records.quote: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral with diagouals intersecting at F
records.stem: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral with diagonals intersecting at F, $X \in \overline{AF}$ and $Y \in \overline{DF}$ where $\overline{XY} \parallel \overline{AD}$. Prove that: First: BXYC is cyclic quadrilateral. Second: $m(\angle XBY) = m(\angle XCY)$
solution: Given: ABCD is a quadrilateral inscribed inside a circle, $\overline{XY} \parallel \overline{AD}$
R.T.P.: Prove that: First: BXYC is cyclic quadrilateral. Second: $m(\angle XBY) = m(\angle XCY)$
$\because m(\angle CAD) = m(\angle CBD)$ (both are inscribed and common in arc CD)
$\therefore m(\angle CXY) = m(\angle CBY)$ and they are two inscribed angles on the base $\overline{CY}$ and in one direction of it.
$\therefore m(\angle XBY) = m(\angle XCY)$ because they are both inscribed angles common at arc CD. (Q.E.D 2)

misprints.notes: Previous line gives CAD = CBD and CAD = CXY, so the conclusion should use CBD; also written ∠CXY in the printed line (the page reads ∠CXY = ∠CBY, possibly intended for BXYC cyclic via ∠CBY).

objectives.label: Recognize a cyclic quadrilateral
objectives.description: Recognize a cyclic quadrilateral as a quadrilateral whose four vertices lie on one circle.

objectives.label: Decide cyclic using equal angles on a base
objectives.description: Decide that a quadrilateral is cyclic when two angles drawn on the same base and on the same side of it are equal.

objectives.label: Decide which figures are cyclic
objectives.description: Decide, from the given angles and sides of a figure, whether a quadrilateral is cyclic and explain why.

objectives.label: Prove a quadrilateral is cyclic
objectives.description: Prove that a given quadrilateral is cyclic, and use this to find equal angles, parallel lines or a diameter.
